findings.title: Published main audit run is internally inconsistent (report/register ID divergence; full-domain metadata over a one-report inventory)
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: both amended published runs still carry RECONCILIATION_2026-10-12.md plus HISTORICAL.md, and the 9c0b88c register remains 1:1 with findings.json (336 findings). Residual unchanged: docs/audits/repo-deep-dive/mainecybertech-20261004-full-main-9c0b88c/audit_manifest.json advertises 43 domains, but that directory contains only one lens report (lens_focused_security_supply_chain_ci.md), no _domains/ directory and no NN_*.md reports, so the 'full-domain metadata over a one-report inventory' half is still not republished.

findings.title: docs/audits/README.md documents a run contract that contradicts the pack and the actual runs, and its Runs table omits all three repo-deep-dive runs
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: docs/audits/README.md:30-73 documents the canonical run contract (required finals, status vocabulary, reconciliation binding) and the Runs table at README.md:110-116 now lists the 905ed63 fast run, the 7dd0402 full run marked (latest), and the 2026-10-21 portal-modules run. The prior omission is closed at this commit.

findings.title: Finding identity is not stable across runs (deterministic IDs reused; legacy area codes persist), so verification status does not carry
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: docs/audits/repo-deep-dive/mainecybertech-20261011-0426-full-main-8d299b8/DUPLICATE_AND_ID_MAP.md:77 documents the canonical-ID+title identity policy and the alias merge map, but the policy still exists only inside that one run; there is no pack-level or repository-level carry-forward mechanism, so identity remains a per-run document.
